== Summary ==
Identified: [[Jack Douglass]] (left, hair in a bun, glasses, a beard, and a black sunset-graphic tee; same face as his named 2025 Worlds photographs), [[Nathan Davis]] (right, blue Seattle cap and a black Star Wars tee; same face and cap as [[:File:Nathan Davis 2025 World Championship.jpg]]), and [[Justin Miyashiro]] (grey zip hoodie in the background, and the portrait on the JUSTIN M / joyjoy 2021 Advocate Award card held in the foreground). Remaining: the smiling player in a navy "TEACHER BY DAY" tee who holds the card, and the seated player in a black "ALPINE VADER 24" tee and glasses.


The 2025 Oregon State Championship in a private basement in Portland (21 June 2025).

* '''Event:''' [[2025 State Championships]]
* '''Date posted:''' 2025-06-22
* '''Camera date:''' 2025-06-21
* '''Identification:''' [[Jack Douglass]] (left, hair in a bun, glasses, a beard, and a black sunset-graphic tee; same face as his named 2025 Worlds photographs), [[Nathan Davis]] (right, blue Seattle cap and a black Star Wars tee; same face and cap as [[:File:Nathan Davis 2025 World Championship.jpg]]), and [[Justin Miyashiro]] (grey zip hoodie in the background, and the portrait on the JUSTIN M / joyjoy 2021 Advocate Award card held in the foreground). Remaining: the smiling player in a navy "TEACHER BY DAY" tee who holds the card, and the seated player in a black "ALPINE VADER 24" tee and glasses.
